structured.approach: I loaded the backend-steps skill for BE-04. I read the six contracted inputs: feat.tasks and feat.design in full, and the STORY-05/06 and IF-5/IF-6 sections of feat.stories, feat.trd and feat.prd through targeted search. I read the current ap_aging code from the tool view, and used codegraph to check who calls what. I also read ci.py and README.md. Shell commands are denied for BE-04, so I used Glob and Read instead. I mapped TSK-05 and TSK-06 onto the existing module and listed each layer as changed or not changed. Every addition is reduced to the smallest additive form, and signatures stay unchanged. A verifier subagent checked the draft against the sources. I fixed what it found: two internal contradictions (how many existing lines change, and which constants each function uses) and several unlabelled agent-judgement statements.

claims.text: The Backend tasks in scope are TSK-05 (STORY-05, overdue_with_risk) and TSK-06 (STORY-06, overdue_rows_to_json), both in ap_aging.
ap_aging today has one logic module, aging.py, with BUCKETS, days_past_due, bucket_for and aging_buckets. __init__.py exports only aging_buckets, at version 1.4.0.
bucket_for(30) returns "31-60", so overdue_with_risk must never call bucket_for. It applies days > OVERDUE_AFTER_DAYS (30) itself.

Only additive changes are made to aging.py: import json, List added to the typing import on line 4, the constants OVERDUE_AFTER_DAYS = 30 and TWO_PLACES = Decimal("0.01"), and the two new functions. BUCKETS, days_past_due, bucket_for and aging_buckets stay unchanged.
__init__.py exports overdue_with_risk and overdue_rows_to_json in __all__, and takes one minor version step from 1.4.0, owned by TSK-05.
Tests go in a new tests/test_overdue.py using AS_OF = date(2026, 10, 25), with days of 30, 31, 42 and 75. tests/test_aging.py stays unchanged.
No transport, service, database or dependency layer changes. CT-1 serialisation lives in ap_aging as overdue_rows_to_json.
CI discovers tests under tests/ and enforces COVERAGE_MIN = 90.0 plus static checks, so ci.py needs no change.
README.md does not list functions, so it needs no update.
Money stays Decimal (never float), paid invoices are skipped with inv.get("paid"), and the exactly-30-day boundary is tested.

open_questions: BC-1 (non-blocking, Developer): the test file location differs between inputs. feat.stories TK-05.2 says tests/test_aging.py; the later feat.tasks section 2 says a new tests/test_overdue.py. I follow feat.tasks; feat.design B3.5 allows either.
BC-2 (non-blocking, Developer): no input states the exact ap_aging version after the minor step from 1.4.0. It will be proposed in BE-05 for confirmation.

Non-blocking, spine owner: the verifier reported that steps/FEAT-ZD-48600/BE-04/brief_attempt1.md gives task.repo_access at commit aac590a, while this step brief and the input file header give daae080. Please confirm which commit is authoritative.
Carried (non-blocking): RA-1 (one shared branch feature/story for STORY-05 and STORY-06), RA-2 (whether coverage is installed for /usr/bin/python3), TQ-1, TQ-3, TQ-9, PQ-2, DQ-2.
